newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Security Bank injects funds in unit.
newsitem.headline: Security Bank injects funds in unit.

text.p: Security Bank Corp said on Friday it had made an additional investment of 150 million pesos in wholly-owned subsidiary SB Capital Investment Corp.
Assistant corporate secretary Lourdes Crisostomo told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Security Bank would subscribe to 1.5 million common shares of SB Capital worth 100 pesos apiece.
SB Capital recently raised its authorised capital to one billion pesos from 200 million pesos as part of its plan to buy a seat at the Philippine Stock Exchange.
